title: Thesis sequencing samplesheet
description: Sequencing inputs for simulated and biological PacBio HiFi amplicon datasets.

sample.errorMessage: sample must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, or underscores

dataset_id.errorMessage: dataset_id must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, or underscores

data_origin.errorMessage: data_origin must be simulated or biological

workflow_branch.errorMessage: workflow_branch must be controlled or biological

input_stage.errorMessage: input_stage must be analysis_ready (when primer is absent) or primer_present

fastq.errorMessage: fastq must point to an existing .fq.gz or .fastq.gz file with no spaces
